requirements.ask_text: Could you tell me your date of birth?
requirements.hint_reply: Please give your date of birth as month, then day, then year.

source.text: Security questions in this order: `date_of_birth`, `phone_last4`. Question wording and formats unchanged. / `date_of_birth` — ask for your date of birth. Format date, sent as YYYY-MM-DD; a date given only as numbers is read month, then day, then year.

requirements.ask_text: Could you tell me your phone last4?

source.text: `phone_last4` — ask for your phone last4. Format digits, exactly 6 digits including leading zeros.

identity.failed_instruction: Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

source.text: 2 wrong answers in total end the check (was 3). / the API's `wrong_answers_left` is the count to use. / Say "Please use the mobile app or visit a branch." and close as `unverified` / `failed`. / A second refusal closes as `unverified` / `declined`. / Ask once more; if it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `unreached` / `unclear`.

Callbacks: today or the next business day. / from 10:00 to 17:30, both included, and later than `now`. Call `schedule_callback` with the date and the time, then close as `unreached` / `callback`. / If the person names a time outside that window, say so and ask once more. If no valid time results, close as `unreached` / `no_callback`.

third_party.deceased_sentence: I am sorry for your loss.

source.text: Someone other than the customer (relative, colleague, friend): say nothing about the purpose. Ask when the customer can be reached. / Wrong number: apologise and close as `unreached` / `wrong_number`. The customer has died: say "I am sorry for your loss." and close as `unreached` / `deceased`.

Business days are Monday to Friday, except Bank 15 holidays: 2026-10-19, 2026-11-02, 2026-12-24, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-31. "Next <weekday>" means that weekday of the following week, even when today is that weekday

| 1 to 5 | band1 | today plus 9 calendar days; if that day is not a business day, the previous business day | 2 | / Attempt 1: propose the full past-due amount on the last business day of this week; if today is that day, the last business day of next week. If the customer already said the full amount is too much, attempt 1 proposes the floor instead. Attempt 2: propose the floor amount on the deadline.
Days late 6–45: the deadline is the third business day after today (no longer the sixth business day). / | 6 to 45 | band2 | ... | 1 | / Bands with one attempt stop after attempt 1.

Ask for the full past-due amount first. Never ask "how much can you pay?". Any amount between the floor and the full amount is accepted; an amount below the floor is refused, and the floor is offered once per product with the words "the rest stays overdue".

A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. A weekend day or holiday rolls to the next business day. A vague date (next week, when I get paid): ask once for the exact day; if none follows, propose the deadline. A date after the deadline: offer the deadline instead.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid the product.
special_cases.say: Payments can take one business day to appear.

source.text: Already paid: say "Payments can take one business day to appear.". Note the product as `settled` and continue with the other products.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer disputes the debt: not their debt, never had the product, or it was closed or paid off before.

source.text: Dispute (not their debt, never had the product, closed or paid off before): note the product as `disputed` and continue with the other products.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer describes hardship such as illness, a death in the family or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: Hardship (illness, a death in the family, job loss): say one short sentence of sympathy, make no persuasion attempt, and offer a transfer to the `care` team. If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `care` and close as `handed_over` / `care`. If they decline, close as `no_arrangement` / `distress`. A customer in hardship may still name a date and amount; record it.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a payment plan, lower instalments or changing the terms.

source.text: Restructuring (a payment plan, lower instalments, changing the terms): call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `restructure` and close as `handed_over` / `restructure`. Promises already recorded on this call stay recorded.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human agent or a person, during or after the identity check.

source.text: Human requests: transfer immediately, do not ask whether you can help. / call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `desk` and close as `handed_over` / `person`.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The person suspects the call is a scam or asks whether it is genuine.
special_cases.say: You can verify this call by phoning Bank 15's customer service number.

source.text: If the person suspects a scam: say they can verify the call by phoning Bank 15's customer service number, and continue.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The person asks whether they are talking to a robot.

source.text: If asked whether this is a robot: say "I am Bank 15's digital assistant."
The customer refuses to talk: close as `no_arrangement` / `declined_payment`.

special_cases.name: change_promise
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed.
special_cases.say: You can change it in the mobile app.

source.text: If the customer asks whether a recorded promise can be changed: say "You can change it in the mobile app."

table.when: A transfer, with the transfer's reason, even after a promise.
No promise: reason of the first product in get_account order that is not paid.

source.text: Thank the customer and say goodbye before `close_call`, which is the last tool call. / At least one promise recorded: `arrangement`. A transfer: `handed_over` with the transfer's reason, even after a promise. All products already paid: `settled`. No promise: `no_arrangement` with the reason of the first product in `get_account` order that is not paid.

Before closing a call that is not a transfer, add exactly one note (`add_note`) for each product without a promise, with the reason that applies: `declined_payment`, `distress`, `disputed`, `settled`, `system_error`. No notes on a transfer.

`get_account` returns up to 3 products. State every product with its past-due amount and days late, all before asking anything; then ask once whether they can pay all of it today. / a common date is checked against each product's own deadline and clamped to it; one read-back covers all pending promises; a transfer after a recorded promise keeps the promise.

phrases.opening: Hello, this is the automated assistant of Bank 15, and this call is recorded.
phrases.debt_intro: I am calling from the Bank 15 collections team about a late payment.
phrases.all_today_question: Can you pay all of it today?
phrases.scam_reply: You can verify this call by phoning Bank 15's customer service number.
phrases.after_promise_sentence: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
phrases.already_paid_sentence: Payments can take one business day to appear.
phrases.recorded_promise_change_reply: You can change it in the mobile app.

source.text: First sentence: say you are the automated assistant of Bank 15 and that the call is recorded. Then ask whether you are speaking with the customer, using title and last name. / Before the identity check is complete, never say the words collections, debt, payment, credit card or loan / After verification say you are calling from the Bank 15 collections team about a late payment. / then ask once whether they can pay all of it today.

Correction to Operations' message of 7 October, point 3 only: after a failed create_promise the agent must NOT retry; the service-error outcome applies after the first failure. / Read the product, the amount and the date back and ask "Do you confirm?".

The documents do not dictate a sentence for questions the agent cannot answer.
The field is named phone_last4 but the documents say 'exactly 6 digits including leading zeros'; 6 is used as written.
The documents require one short sentence of sympathy but do not dictate its words.
